descriptionByLocale.en:
At Endress+Hauser, progress is made through collaboration. As the world’s leading provider of measuring instruments, our more than 17,000 employees are shaping the future in the field of process automation. Whether it’s innovating and implementing new technologies in a team, working together to develop new devices or strengthening important relationships with different global industries, our work is based on building trusted relationships that help everyone succeed. As a family-run company, we look beyond short-term goals and work to create a future-oriented vision for our employees, our customers and the world in general.

We are looking for an order handling + SAP Master Data Expert – 80-100% (m/f/d) to strengthen our know-how in order processing and SAP master data management at Endress+Hauser Digital Solutions. Digital Solutions drives the digital transformation within Endress+Hauser and supports our customers and colleagues worldwide with intelligent, connected solutions that make processes more efficient and sustainable.

What is at stake here?

Do you enjoy handling customer orders precisely and efficiently while keeping track of the entire process? Do you enjoy working across departments with teams from purchasing, production, logistics and sales? Are you flourishing in a role where you are not only responsible for master data processes, but actively develop them and train and support others?

In this role, you have the opportunity to actively shape order processing and SAP master data management and create sustainable added value. As part of Digital Solutions, you play a central role in managing the entire ordering process – from entry to delivery – and ensure smooth cooperation between all relevant internal departments. You drive the establishment and further development of master data processes and are an important contact person for key and end users in dealing with SAP.

What tasks will you take on?

They shall:

• Record and process customer orders in the ERP system (SAP)

• Check order data including prices, delivery times and material availability

• Ensure coordination with internal departments such as purchasing, production, logistics and sales

• Monitor the entire order process from order receipt to delivery

• Create reporting and evaluations on order status, lead times and bottlenecks

• Taking responsibility for SAP Master Data Management

• Establish, document and continuously develop master data processes

• Train and support key and end users in dealing with master data processes

What do we expect from you?

They:

• Have completed commercial education or a comparable qualification

• Bring at least 5 years of professional experience in order processing

• Have experience in cross-departmental cooperation with various stakeholders

• Have sound ERP skills in SAP (MM/SD/PP)

• Have strong organizational skills to execute multiple tasks on time and efficiently

• Convincing through high communication strength, social competence, teamwork and assertiveness

• Bring problem-solving skills for delivery date changes, faulty parts and complaints

• Master German and English negotiable in word and writing

What can you expect from us?

• A dynamic and innovative working environment at the forefront of digital transformation.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development through versatile training and learning opportunities.

• A flexible and family-friendly work culture that supports work-life balance.

• An attractive compensation package with additional benefits, including health and wellness programs.

• The opportunity to be part of a company that lives sustainability, diversity and a long-term vision.

How do you apply?

To apply, we ask you to upload your documents to our career page. Applications sent to us by e-mail can unfortunately not be considered for data protection reasons.

Agencies, personnel service providers or similar companies are asked to refrain from unsolicited sending of profiles and requests regarding possible cooperation. We do not currently work with external service providers for this position. Unsolicited applications are ignored and deleted without further examination. Thank you for your understanding.

• Stammdatenprozesse etablieren, dokumentieren und kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln

• Key- und End-User im Umgang mit Stammdatenprozessen schulen und unterstützen

At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 18,000 employees, we shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for a Team Lead, Digitalization & Integration Projects to join Endress+Hauser Digital Solutions and lead a team of five professionals in delivering digitalization and integration projects that create tangible value for our customers. Based in Reinach, Switzerland, Digital Solutions is Endress+Hauser Group’s Product Center for Industrial Internet of Things, digitalization, digital communication, integration, Plant Asset Management and digital solutions, helping process industries unlock the value of connected technologies and data.

What is the role about?

Are you an experienced leader who enjoys combining technology, customer needs and commercial opportunities? Do you have the drive to turn digital solutions into successful customer projects? Can you build strong relationships across Sales Centers, Product Centers and Business Development while developing a high-performing team?

As Team Lead, Digitalization & Integration Projects, you will lead a team of five professionals and take responsibility for the technical, commercial and operational direction of project-based Digital Solutions offerings. You will help identify new opportunities, strengthen collaboration across the Endress+Hauser Group and develop scalable ways of delivering digital solutions. This is a hands-on leadership role where your ability to combine project expertise, business understanding and people leadership will contribute directly to the growth of Digital Solutions.

Which tasks will you perform?

You will:

• Lead and develop a team of five professionals, coaching project leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and professional growth.

• Build trusted relationships with Sales Centers, Product Centers, Business Development and other internal stakeholders to align customer needs, opportunities and project execution.

• Drive commercial growth by managing the project pipeline, supporting acquisitions and quotations, and contributing to order intake and strategic customer opportunities.

• Own the technical and commercial direction of project-based Digital Solutions offerings, ensuring solutions are customer-focused, scalable, profitable and aligned with business strategy.

• Identify opportunities to expand repeatable solution offerings by addressing portfolio gaps and developing reusable frameworks, templates and delivery models.

• Drive operational excellence by improving processes, establishing clear ways of working and using relevant KPIs to increase efficiency, transparency and delivery quality.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• Bring proven experience in leading, coaching and developing high-performing teams in project management, business development, digital solutions or a comparable environment.

• Have a strong understanding of Industrial IoT solutions, digital architectures and process automation technologies, including technologies such as HART, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, WirelessHART and APL.

• Combine technical understanding with strong commercial and solution-oriented business acumen, connecting customer needs, technical decisions, project execution and business objectives.

• Are entrepreneurial and growth-oriented, with a hands-on approach and a strong drive to identify opportunities and deliver measurable business impact.

• Build effective relationships and communicate confidently across functions, cultures and decision levels within an international and global matrix organization.

• Are adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating complexity and change while remaining focused on delivering results and continuously developing your knowledge.

• Have experience with sales enablement and project management tools such as Salesforce and Planview.

• Have strong English skills; additional languages are an advantage, and you are willing to travel as required by the role.

What can you expect from us?

• A dynamic and innovative work environment at the forefront of digital transformation.

• A flexible and family-friendly work culture that supports work-life balance.

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health and wellness programs.

• The security and prospects of an international, family-owned company that supports sustainability and diversity and has a long-term vision.

• We promote lifelong learning and provide opportunities to develop your expertise, share knowledge and grow professionally.

• You will work in an international environment where collaboration across teams, products and locations is central to how we develop technology.

• You will have the opportunity to influence our technology direction and help build the capabilities, standards and ways of working that support sustainable growth.

How do you apply?

To apply we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by E-Mail can unfortunately not be considered due to Data Privacy Considerations.

Agencies, HR service providers, or similar entities are kindly requested to refrain from unsolicited submission of profiles and inquiries regarding potential collaboration. Currently, we do not engage with external service providers for this role. Any unsolicited applications will be disregarded and deleted without further consideration. We appreciate your understanding.

In Endress+Hauser il progresso avviene attraverso la collaborazione. In qualità di fornitore leader mondiale di strumenti di misura, i nostri oltre 18.000 dipendenti stanno plasmando il futuro nel campo dell'automazione dei processi. Che si tratti di innovare e implementare nuove tecnologie in team, di collaborare allo sviluppo di nuovi dispositivi o di rafforzare relazioni chiave con vari settori globali, il nostro lavoro si basa sulla costruzione di relazioni di fiducia che aiutano tutti ad avere successo. Essendo un’azienda a conduzione familiare, guardiamo oltre gli obiettivi a breve termine e lavoriamo per creare una visione orientata al futuro per i nostri dipendenti, i nostri clienti e il mondo in generale.

Cerchiamo un ingegnere dell'automazione (software e connettività della macchina) al 100% (m/f/d) che pensi insieme al software della macchina (PLC) e alla connettività della macchina e garantisca che i requisiti siano chiari, testabili e conformi agli standard nella loro implementazione.

Alla Flowtec AG di Reinach, come centro di prodotto, sviluppiamo tecnologie di misurazione della portata e soluzioni per l'automazione dei processi. Nella nostra sede di Reinach lavorano circa 1.600 collaboratori di oltre 52 nazionalità. Endress+Hauser Flowtech AG è rappresentata in sei sedi in tutto il mondo con oltre 2.900 dipendenti.

Di cosa tratta la posizione?

Non vuoi solo “cercare errori”, ma vuoi anche ancorare la qualità nelle prime fasi del ciclo di vita? Comprendi i processi delle macchine, la logica PLC e la connettività (incluso OPC UA), sai strutturare chiaramente i requisiti e, insieme a partner esterni, puoi mettere in funzione in modo affidabile un'ampia gamma di sistemi di macchine? Allora sei nel posto giusto: in questo ruolo combinerai lo sviluppo del software, l'ingegneria dei requisiti per il software della macchina e l'ingegneria della connettività della macchina. Dalla specifica al FAT/SAT e alla messa in servizio.

Compiti
Potrai:

- Strutturare e specificare i requisiti: collaborare con specialisti, operatori e gestione del progetto su software e processi per macchine (sotto forma di modelli di stato, definizioni di interfacce, specifiche di comando, gestione di errori/eccezioni, flussi di sequenze e processi, definizioni di limiti e gestione dei test)
- Condurre revisioni in loco, intraprendere debugging e aggiustamenti selettivi o supporto prototipi del software della macchina con supporto durante l'intero ciclo di vita dei prodotti e delle macchine
- Sviluppare modelli standard OPC UA e modelli informativi per l'integrazione delle macchine, mantenerli coerenti, rivedere professionalmente le implementazioni dei fornitori e verificare la conformità agli standard, inclusa la mappatura e l'integrazione
- Guidare professionalmente i produttori di macchine esterne: impostare e richiedere allineamenti, revisioni e QMS
- Pianificare, eseguire e documentare FAT/SAT e test di integrazione, nonché gestire cicli di correzione iterativi con i fornitori
- Garantire stabilità end-to-end e barriere di sicurezza OT (certificati, policy, protezione degli accessi, gate di qualità, documentazione)

Requisiti
Tu:

- Possedere una laurea o un master in tecnologia dell'automazione, ingegneria dei sistemi, ingegneria elettrica o una qualifica equivalente
- Avere esperienza nello sviluppo di PLC secondo la norma IEC 61131-3 e comprendere molto bene l'automazione, la logica del PLC e i processi delle macchine con sequenze, stati e modelli di errore
- Avere esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di concetti PLC e nell'architettura di sistemi PLC, idealmente con macchine a stati, modalità operative, test e risoluzione dei problemi strutturata
- Lavorare nell'ingegneria dei requisiti in modo strutturato, testabile e orientato agli obiettivi e idealmente avere esperienza nell'ambiente macchina o OT
- Avere know-how in OPC UA, comunicazione industriale e modellazione di interfacce, nonché esperienza in FAT/SAT e nella gestione tecnica dei fornitori
- Comunica con sicurezza in tedesco e inglese e divertiti a lavorare in tutti i reparti con costruzioni elettriche e meccaniche, nonché con altri partecipanti al progetto

Offriamo
- Siamo un'azienda a conduzione familiare con grande impegno e una visione sostenibile.
- Promuoviamo l'apprendimento permanente attraverso una varietà di opportunità di formazione e perfezionamento, trasferimento interno di conoscenze ed e-learning.
- In consultazione con il tuo manager, ti offriamo orari di lavoro flessibili entro l'orario di lavoro applicabile, nonché l'opportunità di lavorare occasionalmente da remoto.
- Oltre ai giorni festivi legali e cantonali concediamo giorni liberi aggiuntivi, che vengono definiti annualmente.
- Sosteniamo i dipendenti con responsabilità familiari, tra l'altro, con congedi per l'altro genitore, congedi per adozione e assistenza retribuita per parenti e figli secondo la normativa.
- Vi offriamo un ambiente internazionale a Reinach con circa 1.600 dipendenti, oltre 52 nazionalità e un'anzianità media di servizio di 10 anni.

Contatto
Per candidarti ti chiediamo di caricare i tuoi documenti sulla nostra pagina delle carriere.

Purtroppo le candidature che ci pervengono via e-mail non possono essere prese in considerazione per motivi di protezione dei dati.

Si pregano agenzie, fornitori di servizi del personale o aziende simili di astenersi dall'inviare profili e richieste di possibili collaborazioni non richiesti. Al momento non stiamo lavorando con fornitori di servizi esterni per questa posizione. Tutte le candidature non richieste provenienti dai fornitori di servizi non verranno prese in considerazione e verranno eliminate senza ulteriore esame. Ti ringraziamo per la comprensione.

Chez Endress+Hauser, le progrès passe par la collaboration. En tant que premier fournisseur mondial d'instruments de mesure, nos plus de 18 000 collaborateurs façonnent l'avenir dans le domaine de l'automatisation des processus. Qu'il s'agisse d'innover et de mettre en œuvre de nouvelles technologies en équipe, de collaborer au développement de nouveaux appareils ou de renforcer des relations clés avec diverses industries mondiales, notre travail est basé sur l'établissement de relations de confiance qui aident chacun à réussir. En tant qu'entreprise familiale, nous regardons au-delà des objectifs à court terme et travaillons à créer une vision d'avenir pour nos collaborateurs, nos clients et le monde en général.

Nous recherchons un ingénieur en automatisation (logiciel machine et connectivité) 100 % (h/f/d) qui réfléchit ensemble aux logiciels machine (PLC) et à la connectivité machine et veille à ce que les exigences soient claires, testables et conformes aux normes dans leur mise en œuvre.

Chez Flowtec AG à Reinach, en tant que centre de produits, nous développons des technologies de mesure de débit et des solutions pour l'automatisation des processus. Environ 1 600 collaborateurs de plus de 52 nationalités travaillent sur notre site de Reinach. Endress+Hauser Flowtech AG est représentée sur six sites dans le monde et compte plus de 2 900 employés.

De quoi parle le poste?

Vous ne voulez pas seulement « rechercher les erreurs », mais vous souhaitez également ancrer la qualité dès le début du cycle de vie? Connaissez-vous les processus des machines, la logique API et la connectivité (y compris OPC UA), êtes-vous en mesure de structurer clairement les exigences et, en collaboration avec des partenaires externes, pouvez-vous mettre en service de manière fiable une large gamme de systèmes de machines? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit: dans ce rôle, vous combinerez le développement de logiciels, l'ingénierie des exigences pour les logiciels des machines et l'ingénierie de la connectivité des machines. De la spécification au FAT/SAT et à la mise en service.

Tâches
Vous allez:

- Structurer et spécifier les exigences: Travailler en collaboration avec les spécialistes, les opérateurs et la direction de projet sur les logiciels et les processus pour les machines (sous forme de modèles d'état, de définitions d'interface, de spécifications de commandes, de gestion des erreurs/exceptions, de flux de séquences et de processus, de définitions de limites et de gestion des tests).
- Effectuer des revues sur site, entreprendre le débogage et les ajustements sélectifs ou le support des prototypes des logiciels de la machine avec un accompagnement sur tout le cycle de vie des produits et des machines
- Développer des modèles standard OPC UA et des modèles d'informations pour l'intégration des machines, les maintenir cohérents, examiner de manière professionnelle les implémentations des fournisseurs et vérifier la conformité aux normes, y compris la cartographie et l'intégration.
- Diriger professionnellement les fabricants de machines externes: mettre en place et demander des alignements, des révisions et un système de gestion de la qualité
- Planifier, réaliser et documenter les tests FAT/SAT et d'intégration, ainsi que gérer les boucles de correction itératives avec les fournisseurs
- Assurer la stabilité de bout en bout et les garde-fous de sécurité OT (certificats, politiques, protection d'accès, contrôle qualité, documentation)

Exigences
Vous:

- Avoir un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en technologie de l'automatisation, en ingénierie des systèmes, en génie électrique ou une qualification comparable
- Avoir de l'expérience dans le développement d'automates selon la norme CEI 61131-3 et comprendre très bien l'automatisation, la logique des automates et les processus machine avec des séquences, des états et des modèles d'erreurs
- Avoir une expérience pratique dans le développement de concepts d'automates et dans l'architecture de systèmes automates, idéalement avec les machines à états, les modes de fonctionnement, les tests et le dépannage structuré
- Travailler en ingénierie des exigences de manière structurée, testable et orientée cible et avoir idéalement une expérience dans l'environnement machine ou OT
- Avoir un savoir-faire en OPC UA, en communication industrielle et modélisation d'interfaces ainsi qu'une expérience en FAT/SAT et en gestion technique des fournisseurs
- Communiquer en toute confiance en allemand et en anglais et aimer travailler dans plusieurs départements de construction électrique et mécanique ainsi qu'avec d'autres participants au projet

Nous offrons
- Nous sommes une entreprise familiale avec un grand engagement et une vision durable.
- Nous promouvons l'apprentissage tout au long de la vie à travers une variété d'opportunités de formation et de perfectionnement, le transfert de connaissances interne et l'apprentissage en ligne.
- En concertation avec votre manager, nous vous proposons des horaires de travail flexibles dans le cadre des horaires de travail applicables ainsi que la possibilité de travailler occasionnellement à distance.
- En plus des jours fériés légaux et cantonaux, nous accordons des jours de congé supplémentaires, définis annuellement.
- Nous accompagnons les salariés ayant des responsabilités familiales avec, entre autres, un congé pour l'autre parent, un congé d'adoption et une garde rémunérée des proches et des enfants conformément à la réglementation.
- Nous vous proposons à Reinach un environnement international avec environ 1.600 collaborateurs, plus de 52 nationalités et une ancienneté moyenne de 10 ans.

Contacter
Pour postuler, nous vous demandons de télécharger vos documents sur notre page carrières.

Malheureusement, les candidatures qui nous parviennent par email ne peuvent être prises en compte pour des raisons de protection des données.
